verdict.rationale: Vector quantization or compression is a fair axis for a vector database, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions quantization, compression, reduced-precision vectors, or a documented accuracy trade-off. The pack covers hybrid search, filtering, multitenancy, backups, security and API specs, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off
